xBRIEFInfo.description: Lifecycle land for GitHub issue #4099 after PR #4185 merged without a tracked completed xBRIEF.

plan.title: docs(features): add a capability map and verifiable documentation-impact contract

narratives.Description: Generated capability index over existing registries plus a declared-versus-touched PR documentation-impact check. HITL taxonomy locked in the committed overlay. Shipped in PR #4185 (merge f2d6e00d). This file is the post-merge completed-tracked land (#3264 / #3476); the product work already merged.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4099. Parent #4085. Bound by successor lean 5514567780 and verified-claims table 5515165945.
narratives.Overview: Audience-based capability index pointing at canonical command, conceptual documentation, status, gotchas, and examples. Pair with an explicit PR documentation-impact declaration and a focused verifier so new features and withdrawals propagate beyond implementation-local pages. #447 remains the rule body by reference.

items.title: Lock HITL audience/status taxonomy in the committed overlay

narrative.Acceptance: Given the committed capability overlay, when it is read, then audience and status values are a closed enum approved at HITL.

items.title: Generate a user-facing capability index from existing registries

narrative.Acceptance: Given the overlay and registries, when the index is generated, then one page lists current capabilities with audience, status, canonical command, conceptual source, gotchas, and example or explicit none.

items.title: Fail-closed documentation-impact declaration versus touched closed surfaces

narrative.Acceptance: Given a PR body, when verify:docs-impact runs, then change_class/surfaces are machine-checked against added or removed command, skill-trigger, help, and docs-site surfaces; rationale is data not a waiver.

items.title: Keep #447 as the rule body by reference; do not duplicate it

narrative.Acceptance: When the new verifier lands, then #447 same-PR documentation rules remain intact and are referenced rather than restated.

references.title: Issue #4099: docs(features): add a capability map and verifiable documentation-impact contract

commands.command: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/docs packages/core/src/check

acceptance.derived_reason: Product AC shipped in PR #4185. This land records delivery; focused vitest is the stated local check from that PR.

clauses.text: One generated index lists current capabilities with audience, status, canonical command, conceptual source, gotchas, and example or explicit none.
Feature PRs declare affected documentation surfaces or no user-doc impact; the declaration is machine-checked for presence and valid values.
